payload.headline: Microsoft holds 489.93 above support; no new news, hold and swing plan unchanged

summary.thesis: The business is growing faster and more profitably, but free cash flow is shrinking and the price already assumes a lot.
summary.decision: Long-term hold with an add level at 474.82; swing entry stays at 485.06 with a 475.34 stop and a 503.99 target.

payload.happening: Microsoft closed at 489.93, down 1.25% on the day. That puts it in today's price zone of 485.58–490.27, just above the 475.34–485.06 support zone. There is no new news since the last note, and the next earnings report is on 2027-01-27.
payload.business: Demand is improving. Quarterly sales grew 18.8% from a year earlier, up from 18.3% two quarters ago. Operating margin, the share of each sales dollar left after running costs, rose to 47.1% from 46.27%. Analysts raised next year's earnings-per-share estimate to 24.2 from 23.68 a month ago. The weak spot is cash. Trailing free cash flow, the cash left after spending on the business, fell to 60.0B from 78.0B. The filings note that each dollar invested now earns 30¢ a year, against 51¢ three years ago. In plain words, heavy spending is not paying back yet. The balance sheet is not at risk: net cash is 29.0B and liquidity is 64.5B. Yesterday's note cited a reported outage. Nothing in DATA shows it touching sales or margins, so it counts as sentiment, not business. The four new risk headings in the annual report are a governance item to read, not a change to the numbers.

worth.text: The methods disagree sharply. A cash-flow model (DCF), which values the company on the free cash it can produce in future, gives 183.71 to 295.41 with a base of 222.45. That is far below the price. To justify 489.93 on cash flow, free cash flow would need to start growing at about 39.3% a year. The model caps starting growth at 30%, and even that gives only 350.66. Against its own history the picture is different. Valued on price-to-sales (company value divided by yearly sales) at its usual 5-year levels, the stock is worth 474.82 to 591.77, with a midpoint of 534.4. The gap between the methods comes from one assumption: whether the 60.0B of trailing free cash flow is a temporary dip caused by heavy spending, or the new normal. On earnings it costs 25.6 times trailing profit and 20.2 times next year's estimate. Against peers it is expensive: 10.5 times sales versus a peer median of 3.7. My fair range is 474.82–534.4, the lower half of the own-history band, because the cash-flow method keeps pulling the value down.
worth.key_assumption: The spending that cut free cash flow from 78.0B to 60.0B turns back into cash, so the stock's own sales-multiple history is a fair guide and today's cash flow is not.

bull: Sales growth is speeding up: 18.8% in the latest quarter against 18.3% two quarters ago.
Profitability is rising: operating margin is 47.1%, up from 46.27%, and net cash is 29.0B.
Estimates are moving up: next year's EPS estimate is 24.2, up from 23.68 a month ago, which puts the stock at 20.2 times next year's earnings.
bear: Free cash flow fell to 60.0B from 78.0B, and each invested dollar now earns 30¢ against 51¢ three years ago.
The price needs about 39.3% starting cash-flow growth to make sense; the base cash-flow value is only 222.45.
It costs 10.5 times sales against a peer median of 3.7, which leaves little room for a miss.

levels.what: Today's close is inside the 474.82–534.4 fair range. Nothing here calls for selling, and it is not cheap enough to add.
The bottom of the fair range, just below the 475.34–485.06 support zone. This is the add level.
The bottom of the lower support zone (464.55–471.29). A close below it breaks both support zones and the fair range. In that case, no new adds until the 2027-01-27 report.

longterm.why: The business is getting stronger, but free cash flow is shrinking and two of three valuation measures lean expensive. Hold, and add only at 474.82.

swing.why: The price held above the support zone, so the plan stands. Buy at 485.06, the top of the zone, rather than chasing 489.93, with a stop at 475.34. The target is 503.99, the bottom of the first resistance zone, because the 20-day average at 516.38 is falling and the stock is trading in a range.

decision.timing: Options expiring 2026-12-18 price a 7.4% move, so the swing target fits inside that window. Any swing position closes before the 2027-01-27 report, which options expiring 2027-02-19 price at a 14.3% move. Long-term money beyond the 474.82 add waits for that report's free-cash-flow figure.

change_mind: The 2027-01-27 report shows trailing free cash flow climbing back toward 78.0B. That would support the top of the range at 534.4 and turn hold into add.
A close below 464.55 breaks both support zones. That would end the swing setup and pause adds until the report.
The next-year EPS estimate falls back below 23.68, or quarterly sales growth drops below the 17.91% trailing pace. Either would weaken the growth case that the own-history valuation relies on.
payload.what_changed: Unchanged: hold and the 485.06 swing entry stay; the close of 489.93 held above the 475.34–485.06 support zone and there was no new news since the last note.
